# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirty-nine at the time of his death
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and former store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick Moore was a tall, handsome man with a high color, light-brown hair, and a striking facial resemblance to his double cousin George. His most distinctive feature was his eyes, having one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick was handsome and dashing, but possessed a small and ugly soul. He was selfish and volatile, quickly losing interest in things once he acquired them. He had a reputation for drinking and galavanting, and was generally considered fit for little good by his neighbors.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)_

## Traits

- Handsome and dashing  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>
- Selfish and fickle  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>
- Inclined to heavy drinking  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seafaring  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Leslie West by using financial leverage against her mother  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>

## History

Dick Moore grew up in Four Winds, working in his father's store during the winters and going to sea in the summers. He became enamored with Leslie West, who repeatedly spurned his advances. Desiring her, Dick manipulated her mother, Rose West, by threatening to have his father foreclose the overdue mortgage on the West farm unless Leslie agreed to marry him. Leslie reluctantly consented in order to save her mother's home, and they were married when she was sixteen. Following her mother's death the next year, Dick left Four Winds on a voyage to Cuba aboard the ship Four Sisters. While in Cuba, Dick contracted yellow fever and died shortly after the ship was forced to leave without him. Because his double cousin, George Moore, stayed behind to nurse him and subsequently suffered an injury that caused total amnesia, George was mistaken for Dick and brought back to Four Winds by Captain Jim, a mistake that remained undiscovered for thirteen years.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c11 P31](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0031), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Abner Moore, a storekeeper at the Glen in Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023)</sub>
- Had a double cousin named George Moore who closely resembled him  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
